description: Re-expresses a dense response in plain English while preserving its substance. Use for /plain, "say that in plain English", "de-jargon this", "unpack that", or "explain that like a normal person". Targets the previous assistant message unless the user supplies another passage. Picture mode, only when asked (/plain show, or "show me" about an answer), re-explains with the smallest plain-text picture - pseudocode, a call tree, a component or file tree, or a diff of a tree.
